name: Zendikari Krakens
description: Sea monsters said to embody blue's free will and self-determination, spending most of their adult lives in the depths.

description_citations.text: "Blue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora declares a quest from Thassa and leads the tritons out to the open sea on the leviathan to hunt krakens.
timeline.quote: "Then consider this a quest from Thassa," said Kiora.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

pages_say.description: Fearsome sea monsters that can lay waste to land and sea and that seemingly only the gods command.
